title: onobrychis tommasinii subf. fulgens
intro: Onobrychis tommasinii subf. fulgens, commonly known as Tommasini's yellow melilot, is a plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae) that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as fever and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tommasini's yellow melilot include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
